population: all unique dialogue IDs in the manuscript's test and replication purchase cohorts, N=1391
sample: pool both cohorts, sort IDs by SHA256('review-label-v1-20261123|' + id) asc; take first 48; equal-probability pseudorandom sample without replacement, independent of reference values, conflicts and predictions
target: the last unambiguously selected showtime before the purchase call, local wall-clock minute of day
evidence_priority: user accepts a single offered time
user's ordinal or earliest/latest choice uniquely resolves against an offered list
ambiguity: decline, conditional intention, alternatives without unique selection, ambiguity about AM/PM not resolved by context, or irreconcilable later turns are unresolved; options, descriptions, show duration, arrival or past showings alone are insufficient. Use the final active choice. Allow conventional 24-hour notation.
reader: one model reviewer sees pseudo-ID and complete raw user/assistant turns only. Prior general awareness of the discovered reference issue is disclosed. No official time, per-case historic conflict flags or model predictions are presented. Independently fill separate human A/B forms with time/status and supporting turn numbers; record disagreements and adjudication separately.
analysis: after fixing the blind judgments and recording SHA256, compare clock minutes to independently normalized official times. Report confirmed disagreement among all 48, agreement, unresolved, disagreement among jointly resolvable, and conservative lower/upper bounds assigning unresolved either way. Scientific target is these sampled evaluation cohorts, not all TicketTalk. Marginal Wilson 95% intervals and simultaneous identification/sampling interval using Bonferroni-Wilson. Subjectivity of the reviewer and template dependence additional. Exact or agreement of human annotators only after two independent human forms are available.
training_sensitivity: Use original 1913 training dialogues and 235 development calibration dialogues. Compare original weak supervision (both recent and field_support), removal only of training rows where pre-existing explicit confirmation rule and unambiguous official time disagree, and same-size uniform random removal (fixed seed 45127). Train vocabulary, mention model and calibration afresh using original pipeline and identical development IDs, official development labels and threshold 0.5, evaluate unchanged cohort IDs and original reference orders. Also evaluate old confirmation rule sensitivity and the new blind sample separately. All comparisons retrospective; never promote cleaned arm based on old tests.
